jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
HireMate is revolutionizing the talent acquisition space with AI-driven intelligence. We are seeking a Staff/Senior Frontend Engineer to spearhead the architecture of our core web platform. You will build highly scalable, interactive UI components using React 18, TypeScript, and modern state management, impacting thousands of global recruiters daily.

### Why Join Us?
We operate like an elite sports team—fast-paced, highly collaborative, and heavily invested in your growth. We offer comprehensive benefits including 100% covered health/dental/vision insurance, a 4% 401(k) match, unlimited PTO, and a $1,500 annual home-office stipend.
responsibilities: Architect highly scalable frontend systems from scratch
Establish engineering standards and mentor junior developers
Collaborate with product and design to craft pixel-perfect, accessible UIs
Optimize rendering performance and manage complex state logic
Lead code reviews and maintain strict testing coverage

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At HireMate, we build the engine that powers modern recruiting. We are looking for a strategic Product Manager to own our core matching algorithm and enterprise dashboard. You will synthesize market research, define the roadmap, and work closely with AI researchers and engineers to deliver features that drive massive business impact.

### What We Offer
Beyond a competitive salary and equity package, you will receive full medical/dental benefits, flexible remote work options, generous parental leave, and an annual learning & development budget to attend global conferences.
requirements: Excellent PRD writing and stakeholder alignment
Experience in HR-Tech or AI is a plus
responsibilities: Define and execute a robust 12-month product roadmap
Write comprehensive PRDs and user stories
Conduct deep-dive market analysis and customer interviews
Track KPIs and iterate rapidly based on user feedback
Align cross-functional teams across engineering, marketing, and sales

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
HireMate believes that enterprise software shouldn't be ugly or hard to use. We need a visionary UX Designer to lead the end-to-end design lifecycle for our platform. From low-fidelity wireframes to complex interactive prototypes in Figma, you will shape intuitive experiences that abstract away the complexity of AI-driven recruiting.

### Perks & Benefits
We value creativity and well-being. Enjoy 100% remote work flexibility, premium health insurance coverage, a comprehensive wellness stipend, 401(k) matching, and an annual company retreat.
requirements: Strong portfolio showcasing B2B SaaS workflows
responsibilities: Design high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes
Conduct extensive user research and usability testing sessions
Build and maintain our global design system
Collaborate tightly with frontend engineers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation
Advocate for user-centric design principles across the organization

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Join HireMate's core engineering squad as a Full Stack Developer! You will be instrumental in building both our React-based frontend and our highly performant Node.js/PostgreSQL backend. We are an early-stage, fast-growing startup where your code will ship to production on day one.

### Comprehensive Benefits
We offer a highly competitive compensation package including generous equity, top-tier health/dental/vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, 4 weeks of paid vacation, and a $1,000 work-from-home setup budget.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain scalable full-stack features end-to-end
Design robust database schemas and optimize query performance
Build secure and scalable RESTful APIs
Implement automated CI/CD pipelines and write comprehensive tests
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
HireMate is looking for a dynamic Marketing Manager to amplify our brand presence and drive B2B customer acquisition. You will own the full funnel—from SEO and content strategy to digital advertising and brand positioning, directly impacting our ARR growth.

### The Perks
Join a fully remote, globally distributed team. We provide premium health insurance, competitive equity, flexible PTO, paid parental leave, and a dedicated budget for professional development and marketing certifications.
requirements: Proficiency with Google Analytics, Hubspot, and CRM tools
Strong copywriting and brand storytelling skills
responsibilities: Design and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies
Manage SEO/SEM campaigns to drive qualified enterprise leads
Collaborate with sales to optimize the conversion funnel
Oversee content creation including whitepapers, case studies, and blog posts
Track and report on campaign ROI and key marketing KPIs
